name_english: The Yoga of the Threefold Division of Faith
summary_short: Krishna explains how faith, food, speech, action, and discipline are shaped by the three gunas.
summary_medium: This chapter shows that a person’s faith reflects their inner nature. It explains how sattvic, rajasic, and tamasic tendencies influence worship, food, speech, austerity, and charity.
summary_detailed: Faith according to the three gunas.
Why intention matters more than appearance.
what_you_learn: How speech can heal or harm.
usage_note_for_app: Chapter 17 is ideal for daily habit nudges, lifestyle suggestions, and intention-based guidance.
